The scene changed and JEV could not absorb it on its own (the running motion's goal is stale); it paused the motion and holds the pose. diagnostics.change says what: shape = the decided grasp no longer fits the object as it is perceived now (it toppled or fell: diagnostics.fit says which side or width failed) and no reachable grasp was found for it, moved = the object moved to where this arm cannot take it: the new goal lies beyond its reach or the arm would meet the robot's own body there or an object the perception sees (diagnostics.obstacle: obj:<name>), or the arm cannot play the re-planned motion to it from here (diagnostics.unplayable: its rows end for good before the approach point, approach_shortfall_m) (diagnostics.reason and diagnostics.plan; a move whose goal stays reachable is followed without a pause; diagnostics.other_arm says whether the other arm reaches it: when reachable, execute that arm's motion), contact = the hand touched something unexpected before the grasp, a contact present since the motion's start not counted unless the motion pressed it harder (diagnostics.force_n; start_contact and grown_to_n when it grew: perceive again, the scene is not as it was perceived), pushed = the hand itself pushed the bound object (it moved while the hand touched it: diagnostics.displacement_m, force_n, where pads | hand), lost = the bound object is gone from where the camera sees it (detect_objects again and bind the id it lists with jev_modify bindings, or jev_stop), body = the robot's body moved so far that the motion's goal no longer lies where the arm's rows go and re-planning from here did not take it (diagnostics.moved_m, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, goal_row_error_m, goal_shortfall_m), off_goal = the jaws did not close: the hand stands off the object's grasp point (diagnostics.error_m, error_hand_m), blocked = the object stopped the hand before the grasp (diagnostics.part, force_n, pad_above_top_m), stalled = the hand stayed stopped behind its plan and the arm now holds where it stands, its push released (diagnostics.tracking_error_m, since_s, contact, goal_shortfall_m). Perceive, jev_query_options (the menu says which motions fit now), then jev_execute the fitting motion (it supersedes the paused one), jev_modify with new bindings or an insight to re-decide and resume, or jev_stop.
